profile_text.body:
Snowflake is a for-profit public company founded in 2012 and headquartered in Bozeman, MT. It operates what it describes as an AI Data Cloud, a platform intended to support data engineering, analytics, application development, and AI workloads within a single environment. The company's site states that its platform covers the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and processing through modeling and the building and sharing of data and AI applications, and that it eliminates data silos across an organization.

On the AI product side, Snowflake offers two tracked products. Snowflake Arctic is an enterprise-focused large language model released under the Apache 2.0 license, designed for commercial use with integration into the data cloud. Snowflake Cortex is a native AI layer within the data cloud that provides LLM functions, vector search, and data residency controls, with governance managed through Snowflake Horizon. The company's site also references a Snowflake Postgres offering and mentions customers including Booking.com and Landing AI.

Snowflake trades on a public exchange under the ticker SNOW and carries the SEC CIK 0001640147. Its most recently filed 10-K, covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of $4,683,946,000. No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts.
